We need DBE for formula C12H15O0Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, S, halogens counted as H). For halogens, treat as H. So effective H = H + halogens = 15 + 1 = 16. No N. So DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 12 - 16/2 +1 = 12 -8 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we can call retrieve_dbe_formula.
